# Draft:Participants of the Crusades

----
This is a list of political, military, and religious entities and polities that participated in the Crusades (c. 1095–1699). Participation varied by crusade and over time, and inclusion in this list does not imply continuous or unified involvement. This list is not exhaustive.
Crusaders
State actors
* Papal States
* Byzantine Empire (Sometimes)
* Kingdom of Jerusalem
* Principality of Antioch
* County of Tripoli
* Holy Roman Empire
Non-crusaders
State actors
Muslims
* Seljuk Empire
* Fatimids Caliphate
* Abbasid Caliphate
* Zengid Dynasty
* Sultanate of Rum
* Ayyubid Sultanate
* Mamluk Sultanate
* Ottoman Empire
